headline: CISA adds exploited Collabora Online and VeloCloud flaws to KEV as PHP2Shell exploitation and the LiteLLM compromise continue

bullets.text: New since the last SITREP: CISA added two actively exploited critical flaws to KEV on Oct 23, an OS command injection in Collabora Online's built-in CODE server (CVE-2026-110447) and a SQL injection in Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator (CVE-2026-114625). The federal due date for both is Oct 26.

PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-109618, CVE-2026-109619) lets an unauthenticated attacker run code through PHP. Fixes are in 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36 and 8.2.35. Exploit attempts are hitting millions of hosts, some trying to deploy Mirai. A third bug, CVE-2026-115560, won't get an emergency fix.

LiteLLM 1.107.0 on PyPI and Docker shipped a credential stealer and backdoor after attackers got into the release pipeline. Microsoft's analysis says it stole credentials through Python startup hooks, taking cloud keys, secrets and environment variables.

Developer platforms remain a target: Railway says some customer environment-variable secrets were decrypted and is telling all users to rotate keys, and Microsoft attributes the ConnectWise cloud-backup supply-chain attack, which reached more than 2,250 Microsoft 365 tenants, to Storm-0940.
Ruby fixed three regex engine bugs behind four critical GitLab RCE flaws, and Pillow has a heap overflow in FlashPix JPEG decoding that allows code execution from a crafted image (CVE-2026-112398).
Breaches confirmed: Quest Diagnostics patient personal and health data, 11.7 million CAPCOM ID accounts, and a firewall and VPN campaign that exposed over 70,000 credentials.

actions: Patch or take offline Collabora Online (CODE server) and Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator; check both for signs of compromise.
Update PHP to 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36 or 8.2.35, rebuild images that bundle PHP, and restart PHP-FPM or Apache.
Search lockfiles, images and CI caches for litellm 1.107.0. If it ever ran, treat the machine as compromised and rotate every credential it could read.
If you deploy on Railway, rotate every secret stored there and revoke the old values at each provider.
Patch self-managed GitLab and update Ruby and Pillow in your apps and images.
If ConnectWise cloud backup is connected to your Microsoft 365, review that app's consent and its sign-ins.
